svg.font-family: NotoSansEmb, NotoSansJPEmb, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The six perfections: from this shore, moved by the bodhisattva vows, through giving, ethical discipline, patience, vigour and meditation, all guided by wisdom, to the other shore of awakening.
svg.title: Six Perfections Diagram v1
svg.text: 六波羅蜜 · pāramitā — crossing from this shore to the other
shigan 此岸 · suffering, anger, fear
rokuharamitsu 六波羅蜜 · the six perfections
Wisdom guides the other five · Perfection of Wisdom sūtras
Traditional order: wisdom is named last and leads the rest.
Glosses: Thich Nhat Hanh, The Heart of the Buddha's Teaching, ch. 25 (03 shortened).
